chunks: Whatever is in it from Abū al-Aʿazz al-Nakhkhās, I have narrated it from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā al-ʿAṭṭār, from Ibrāhīm ibn Hāshim, from Ṣafwān ibn Yaḥyā and Muḥammad ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Abū al-Aʿazz al-Nakhkhās.

key_terms.أَبِي الْأَعَزِّ النَّخَّاسِ: Abū al-Aʿazz al-Nakhkhās, the narrator to whom this transmission route leads
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; a statement identifying the author’s route of narration

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Abū al-Aʿazz al-Nakhkhās in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage states the transmission chain for reports narrated from Abū al-Aʿazz al-Nakhkhās in the book. It identifies the author’s route of narration through his father and a sequence of transmitters, serving as a hadith isnad clarification.
